name: Kilo Code CLI
nameMangling: sanitize(server) + _ + sanitize(tool), where sanitize turns [^a-zA-Z0-9_-] into _; no prefix and no length cap, as OpenCode's (V, packages/opencode/src/mcp/catalog.ts:117-119 at v7.8.18)
sources: github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode at v7.8.18 (b817615): packages/core/src/global.ts:24, packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts:72-75, 206-216, 460-482, 974-982, 1014-1034, packages/opencode/src/config/managed.ts:20-31, packages/opencode/src/kilocode/config/config.ts:41, packages/core/src/v1/config/mcp.ts (OpenCode 1.19.4's schema plus `env` as an alias for `environment`), packages/opencode/src/config/variable.ts:27-60, packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/mcp.ts:396-445, 476, packages/opencode/src/mcp/catalog.ts:117-119 (lane Q, third chat, 3 Nov 2026)
notes: Files in ~/.config/kilo (XDG_CONFIG_HOME; KILO_CONFIG_DIR does not move them, it adds a folder Kilo reads later like a project's, V config.ts:818-836) merge config.json, kilo.json, kilo.jsonc, opencode.json, opencode.jsonc in that order with mergeDeep, so `mcp` entries merge by name and a server of the same name in a later file wins (V). `kilo mcp add` writes the first existing of kilo.jsonc, kilo.json, opencode.jsonc, opencode.json in KILO_CONFIG_DIR or that folder, else kilo.json, with jsonc-parser modify, keeping comments (V, cli/cmd/mcp.ts:396-445, 476); derm writes kilo.json in the global folder. Entries are OpenCode's: local {type, command argv, environment (or env), enabled, timeout} or remote {type, url, headers, oauth, enabled, timeout} (V). {env:VAR} and {file:path} are substituted in the raw text of global files only; a project file may not read the environment (V, variable.ts:27-60), so derm refuses both forms in entry values as for OpenCode. Managed files: every one of the four names in /etc/kilo or /Library/Application Support/kilo, then the macOS plist domain ai.opencode.managed (V, managed.ts, config.ts:974-982).

gate.where: ~/.config/kilo/kilo.json plugin array (a file: URL), or ~/.config/kilo/plugin/derm.ts; tool.execute.before

coverage.note: a throw stops the call (run); Kilo never fires permission.ask, so an ask is the daemon approver or deny; - stays in server names; XDG_CONFIG_HOME moves the folder and KILO_CONFIG_CONTENT replaces the config; npm plugins whose engines.opencode does not match are skipped, so the package declares none (lane I, applied by integration w2)
